_comment: What the scene placement rules accept as seated (one home, review 2 C5; audit 2026-09-24 N27):
codeverse3d/spatial/scene_placement.py (the gate) and runtime_js/lib/host_placement.mjs (the boot-time settle) both read this file,
so the gate never reports what the settle deliberately leaves.
buried_ok: below ground by definition.  slope_ok: follows the terrain, so sunk uphill by construction.
partial_ok: driven / grown in, fine up to partial_ok_frac of its height buried.
A name matches when one of its to_snake words is listed; list plurals explicitly.
